text:
Ivy: FYI TrellisPay activity dropped steeply this week, procurement kicked off an RFP and their CTO left. Renewal in ~40 days. Champion Sam asked for a cost/latency comparison vs a cheaper stack.

Maya: How big is the drop? Which signals?

Ivy: API tokens down ~43% last 7d vs prior 30d window, active sessions 118 -> 66. Embeds and rerank highest declines. Also noticed an increase in client-side batch sizes in user-agent.

procurement-bot: Renewal alert: TRE-001 renewal in 40 days. Health score fell 84 -> 60.

Sam: We're pushing an internal RFP to evaluate SkyStack. Cost is first priority but continuity matters. Can you give a short deck and an ops checklist?

Diego: I'll pull route-level P95 latency and a prefix heatmap and simulate token savings if we enable prefix caching + KV. SQL I plan to run: SELECT prefix, sum(tokens) FROM api_events WHERE acct='TRE-001' AND day >= current_date - interval '30 days' GROUP BY prefix ORDER BY sum(tokens) DESC LIMIT 25;

Lin: I'll draft a one-page comparison: current dedicated cost (3 reserved nodes) vs estimated SkyStack quantized TCO, plus sensitivity to batch size and caching.

Nora: Commercial: we can offer a short retention credit. Proposal options: 1) 10% credit on overages for 90 days with a 6-month extension, 2) 5% one-time credit without extension. Legal needs to sign off, ETA EOD.

Ivy: We also need a 30m enablement with their new procurement lead. Proposed slots tomorrow 11:00am PT or 2:00pm PT. Who from eng can join?

Diego: I can demo ops tweaks at 11:00am PT (cache + batching toggles + simulated before/after).

Lin: I'll join to run the cost slides and the quick FAQ on vendor tradeoffs (model freshness, latency variance, rollback).

Maya: Action items: Diego post heatmap + sim (ETA 1h); Lin post slide draft (ETA 5pm PT); Nora confirm credit language (ETA EOD); Ivy send invite for 11:00am and include a 1-slide pre-read.

Sam: 11:00am works. Please include a short PoC offer to replicate production traffic on a fenced dedicated cluster for 2 weeks so we can compare directly.

Nora: Noted94I'll include PoC language in the offer draft.

Diego: Quick check: no sustained 5xx spike. We saw a 429 uptick on embeds correlating with the batch change, which could lead to degraded UX and churn. I'll include the timeline.

Ivy: Good. If we get the deck and a PoC offer before they finalize vendor scoring, we have a strong chance. Keep this thread tight; post calendar + links here.

procurement-bot: Last contact with champion: 2026-02-28. Priority: high.
